reason: I get creators in for a free meal on barter and my Swiggy/Zomato ads already show me orders. Even if Mitra's fee is free in the pilot, I'd still be paying a creator ₹5,000 cash, and I don't trust influencers to bring people in on a slow weekday.
objection: Why pay cash plus a fee when barter works fine? And who is going to tap +1 at the counter on a busy weekend? I don't believe the counts will be real.
would_change_my_mind: A creator who gets paid only per customer who actually walks in with the code, so I pay nothing if nobody comes.
